notes: 15 days to Physics HL. This is the last full prep week — next Sunday you will be inside the exam window. Physics gets the lion's share of this week. After April 19, pivot to near-full Physics simulation mode until April 28, then pivot hard to English. PanaStudies and Biology modules have been dropped from this week's list — if they are not done, you need to decide now whether to finish them this week or accept the delay. Also: your career plan may be due for an update based on recent conversations about university direction. Talk to your coach when you have a quiet moment.
